#comment: TT XIX : Flower in the Water

objdata.Name: TT XIX : Flower in the Water

Descriptions: Survive a massive attack in Time Twister

Lines.en: User Dave, I detect a massive backup horde of zombies, all of zomboss's final forces united against us!
Lines.zh: 如果想使用道具，可以用金币购买哦！

Lines.en: I'm going to go sleep .... I mean watch the brawl!
Lines.zh: 如果想使用道具，可以用金币购买哦！

Lines.en: Do you hear that, Suburbian pests? That is the sound of reality tearing at the seams. You think you have 'won' because my historical legions lie broken at your feet? Impudent fools! You have merely forced my hand into the abyss!
This timeline is fracturing under the weight of your defiance. Every paradox, every temporal rift, every era I twisted is collapsing inward.
If I cannot possess the past, the present, and your precious little future... THEN NO ONE WILL.
Look upon the water.
Observe the blossoms floating helplessly on the surface. How poetic. How utterly tragic.
Those fragile roots are the only thing anchoring your linear existence together!
I am shattering the chronological floodgates. Many nightmares and monstrosities from across a thousand shattered epochs are descending upon this singular coordinate, all at once!
The tide is rising, the floor is sinking, and the chronal radiation will drown you before the jaws even reach your flesh
This is my final directive. History ends here. WIPE THEM FROM THE SPACE-TIME CONTINUUM!
Zomboss! Wait, Penny, what do we do ... I'm a bit jealous of his power by the way...
User Dave, Survival is highly improbable under these circumstances.
I recommend we use our plant food and conveyor belt plants wisely, prepare for a long endless gauntlet!
This is it penny, the final battle!
Lines.zh: 如果想使用道具，可以用金币购买哦！

Lines.en: WE DID IT! The zombies are gone, the circus carnival beach is clear, and my taco is still dry!
Warning! User Dave, do not celebrate yet. The temporal distortion is accelerating!
By defeating his unified forces, the concentrated chronal energy has reached critical mass! The timeline is collapsing!
Cough ... you think this is over?! Look around you, mindless botanical gardeners!
My army is ash, yes. I have no more foot soldiers to throw into your modern defenses...
But I don't NEED them anymore. The space-time continuum is at absolute zero. The countdown to total erasure has begun!
If I am going to be ripped from reality, I am taking every single one of your precious eras down with me, as well as you and EVERYONE you've ever known!
Behold the culmination of my desperation... THE TIME TWISTER MALFUNCTION CONFIGURATION ... which will be able to spawn infinite zombies out of thin air!
Uh oh... that mechanical noise sounds way bigger than a regular gargantuar...
Critical Alert! A massive, localized Zombot signal is warping directly onto the lawn!
We have less than three minutes before the timeline detonates completely. We must disable it NOW!
